survivorship: L_MLB is accuracy AMONG DEBUTS: only players who reached the majors have a realized MLB quantity. L_UM (translated upper-minors outcomes, seasons Y to Y + 2 capped at 2024) does not require a debut, but it does require reaching Double-A or Triple-A for 300 PA (150 BF), itself a promotion outcome: among hitter rows with no debut by 2024 only about 37% carry it, and non-debuts who stalled below Double-A are on neither label. L_UM is accuracy AMONG PROMOTED players (amendment 1, A1).
